Florida has more than 24 million people. Down in the far south, there are places that still feel untouched. The swamp and the wild are part of everyday life. Join local Harrison and me as we adventure out to one of the last frontiers left in America and meet the locals who live there.

► 🎥 Join for more behind-the-scenes videos: https://innercircle.petersantenello.com/
